description: This file contains deprecated types, functions, and constants related to the Ginkgo testing framework, specifically for handling asynchronous testing, custom reporters, test descriptions, parallel execution, benchmarking, and test reporting. It provides backward compatibility and migration guidance for Ginkgo 2.0.

classes.name: Done
classes.description: Type alias for internal.Done, representing a deprecated pattern for asynchronous testing.

classes.name: Reporter
classes.description: Type alias for reporters.DeprecatedReporter, representing deprecated custom reporters.

classes.name: GinkgoTestDescription
classes.description: Struct representing a deprecated test description, including test text, file info, failure status, and duration.

classes.name: Benchmarker
classes.description: Interface defining methods for benchmarking, now deprecated in favor of Gomega's gmeasure package.

methods.name: RunSpecsWithDefaultAndCustomReporters
methods.description: Runs specs with default and custom reporters, tracking deprecation.

methods.name: RunSpecsWithCustomReporters
methods.description: Runs specs with custom reporters, tracking deprecation.

methods.name: CurrentGinkgoTestDescription
methods.description: Returns a deprecated test description for the current spec, including test text, file info, failure status, and duration.

methods.name: GinkgoParallelNode
methods.description: Returns the parallel node number, deprecated and renamed to GinkgoParallelProcess.

methods.name: Measure
methods.description: A deprecated function for benchmarking, now recommended to use Gomega's gmeasure package.
